name: ugc-two-character-comedy-skit-hook
description: A two-character UGC comedy skit format where an "everyman" character reacts to a relatable financial/lifestyle pain point and a theatrical foil (expert, character, or mascot) dramatically swoops in to roast, school, and convert them. The structural move is *shock reaction → dramatic intervention → roast-to-persuasion → reluctant concession → CTA*.
